name: Fülöpszállás (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of light blue, red and light blue in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Fülöpszállás: a crowned blue shield with a red-clad figure holding a sword.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
